milestone_name: Shared support variant and persistence expansion
title: Multi-profile family registry
done_when: One family can expose several concrete profiles with declarative capability flags instead of ad-hoc conditionals.

milestone_name: Shared support variant and persistence expansion
title: Persistent media and battery-backed storage
done_when: Cartridges, disks, and similar media can persist mutable state through one shared host path.

milestone_name: Shared support variant and persistence expansion
title: RTC and wall-clock service layer
done_when: Machine-local RTC devices consume a shared host time service without leaking host APIs into core logic.

milestone_name: Shared support variant and persistence expansion
title: Removable disk and tape host services
done_when: Late wave-2 families can mount, swap, and persist removable media through shared support plumbing.

title: Game Boy Color and common MBC matrix
done_when: CGB and the common save-backed MBC families are supported under one shared Game Boy family shell.

title: Game Boy link and late-family validation
done_when: The Game Boy family has a defined link/session story and a stronger multi-profile regression set.

title: Master System 1 baseline
done_when: Master System 1 is supported as a first-class profile, not an implied SG-1000 variant.

title: Game Gear and FM/audio family variants
done_when: Game Gear and the main FM/audio deltas are modeled within the Sega 8-bit family shell.

title: Spectrum late-family paging and AY path
done_when: 128K and later paging/audio behavior are stabilized as multi-profile support rather than one-off hacks.

title: Spectrum +3 disk path and variant validation
done_when: Plus-3-class disk-backed variants are supported with shared removable-media plumbing.

title: MMC3 and scanline IRQ path
done_when: The suite supports a post-wave-1 mapper tier without inventing a generic mapper abstraction for all systems.

title: FDS, expansion audio, and profile split
done_when: FDS, expansion audio, and explicit NTSC/PAL profile handling exist within the NES family.

title: C128 baseline profile and VDC path
done_when: C128 is represented as a profile inside the Commodore 64/128 family rather than a separate ad-hoc machine.

title: IEC/1541 pragmatic disk workflow
done_when: One practical and regression-friendly IEC/1541 path exists for the Commodore family.

title: CD-ROM2 path
done_when: The PC Engine family supports CD-ROM2 media and timing without pulling in unrelated CD frameworks.

title: SuperGrafx and family variant matrix
done_when: SuperGrafx and other major profile deltas are modeled cleanly inside the family shell.

title: ECS profiles and chipset deltas
done_when: ECS, A500+, and A600-class profiles exist with explicit chipset and platform deltas.

title: Workbench/floppy hardening
done_when: The Amiga family has a more durable floppy/workbench boot workflow suitable for later waves.

title: WonderSwan family baseline
done_when: WonderSwan, WonderSwan Color, and SwanCrystal have a coherent family shell and one validated baseline profile.

title: Neo Geo Pocket family baseline
done_when: The Neo Geo Pocket family has one validated baseline profile and a clear family-variant model.

title: Atari Lynx family baseline
done_when: The Lynx family is onboarded as a hybrid handheld without destabilizing the simpler handheld abstractions.

title: Game Boy Advance family baseline
done_when: The GBA family is onboarded as the first ARM-era handheld within the non-D roadmap.

title: Shared tooling conventions and persistence matrix
done_when: Completed family binaries share startup conventions, profile selection behavior, and persistent-media handling across the expanded families.

title: Cross-family regression pass
done_when: Wave-2 families participate in one shared regression matrix with profile-aware artifacts.

title: Apple IIe baseline
done_when: Apple IIe boots, renders, accepts input, loads disk media, and participates in the shared validation harness.

title: Atari 800XL baseline
done_when: 800XL with ANTIC, GTIA, and POKEY timing reaches the suite regression harness.

title: MSX1 baseline
done_when: MSX1 boots and runs with an explicit slot model, cartridge media path, and shared validation artifacts.

title: MSX2 extension
done_when: MSX2 extends the MSX family without forcing a second incompatible architecture.

title: BBC Model B baseline
done_when: The BBC Micro family has a validated Model B baseline.

title: CPC 6128 baseline
done_when: The CPC family has a validated 6128 baseline with tape/floppy-capable media support.

title: CoCo 2 baseline
done_when: The Color Computer family has a validated CoCo 2 baseline.

title: CoCo 3 extension
done_when: The CoCo 3 extends the family with explicit GIME-era deltas.

title: ColecoVision baseline
done_when: The ColecoVision family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Intellivision baseline
done_when: The Intellivision family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Atari 7800 baseline
done_when: The 7800 family reaches one validated baseline profile using the hybrid scheduler path.

title: Vectrex baseline
done_when: The suite hosts one validated vector-display family without introducing a second beam execution path.

title: Genesis cart-only baseline
done_when: The Genesis family reaches a validated cart-only baseline profile.

title: SNES baseline
done_when: The SNES family reaches a validated baseline profile under the hybrid scheduler path.

title: Neo Geo AES/MVS baseline
done_when: The Neo Geo family reaches a validated cart-only baseline profile.

title: Atari ST baseline
done_when: The Atari ST family reaches a validated baseline profile with shared media, audio, and video plumbing.

title: Flagship regression matrix
done_when: Wave-3 families join one uniform regression matrix with comparable artifacts and acceptance criteria.

title: Shared media import path across flagship computers and consoles
done_when: The host media/import layer handles the wave-3 mix without per-family host-glue forks.

title: Apple IIgs baseline
done_when: The Apple IIgs family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Archimedes baseline
done_when: The Archimedes family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Risc PC extension
done_when: The Risc PC extends the Acorn ARM family without creating a separate execution-substrate track.

title: Atari Falcon baseline
done_when: The Falcon reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: X68000 baseline
done_when: The X68000 family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: PC-8801 baseline
done_when: The NEC PC-88/98 family reaches one practical baseline starting with PC-8801.

title: FM Towns and Marty baseline
done_when: The FM Towns family reaches one practical baseline profile.

title: Amiga AGA and CD32 baseline
done_when: The Amiga family reaches one validated AGA-era baseline and one console-style AGA profile.

title: Mega-CD / Sega CD integration
done_when: The Genesis family supports one CD-based baseline path.

title: 32X integration
done_when: The Genesis family supports one 32X-era baseline path without spawning a second execution-substrate track.

title: Neo Geo CD integration
done_when: The Neo Geo family supports one CD-based baseline path.

title: Virtual Boy baseline
done_when: The Virtual Boy family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Jaguar / Jaguar CD baseline
done_when: The Jaguar family reaches one practical baseline profile and a clear CD-era backlog.

title: Advanced hybrid scheduler regression pass
done_when: Wave-4 families share one timing-focused regression pass across advanced hybrids and workstations.

title: CD and add-on media hardening
done_when: The host layer supports the wave-4 CD/add-on matrix without ad-hoc per-family media handling.

title: Block-execution and event-sync contract
done_when: The suite supports block execution plus timestamped synchronization points without replacing the non-D contract.

title: MMU, cache, and TLB service layer
done_when: The shared support layer exposes the substrate needed by the first D families without forcing a universal CPU model.

title: GPU command-stream and frame-presentation contract
done_when: The shared D support can host command-buffer-style graphics pipelines under one host-facing video path.

title: D-era validation harness
done_when: The validation harness can capture and compare the kinds of artifacts the first D systems need.

title: 3DO baseline
done_when: The 3DO family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: PlayStation baseline
done_when: The PlayStation family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Nintendo 64 baseline
done_when: The Nintendo 64 family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Dreamcast baseline
done_when: The Dreamcast family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Nintendo DS baseline
done_when: The Nintendo DS family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: PSP baseline
done_when: The PSP family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: GameCube baseline
done_when: The GameCube family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: Wii baseline
done_when: The Wii family reaches one validated baseline profile.

title: D-era regression matrix and artifact capture
done_when: The D families share one regression matrix with comparable graphics and audio artifacts.

title: D-era save-state and determinism study
done_when: The suite has a documented determinism and save-state policy for the first D wave.

title: Catalog intake rules and promotion criteria
done_when: There is a documented policy for promoting a family from archive/intake into an implementation wave.

title: Long-tail family shell and backlog tooling
done_when: The suite can record family metadata, reference media and firmware needs, and research status without pretending implementation has started.

title: Early-console cluster plan
done_when: The remaining early-console families are grouped by likely runtime fit and promotion priority.

title: Handheld oddities cluster plan
done_when: The remaining handheld, mobile, and educational families are grouped by likely runtime fit and promotion priority.

title: 6502/Z80 long-tail computer cluster plan
done_when: The remaining 6502/Z80-focused computer families are grouped into a coherent promotion backlog.

title: Advanced long-tail computer cluster plan
done_when: The remaining advanced and region-specific computer families are grouped into a coherent promotion backlog.

title: Multimedia oddities cluster plan
done_when: The multimedia-console families are grouped with explicit reasons for promotion or deferral.

title: Edge-console cluster plan
done_when: The educational, toy, and edge-console families are grouped with explicit reasons for promotion or deferral.

title: Saturn and adjacent D-edge research
done_when: The suite has a documented position on saturn_family and adjacent edge-D platforms.

title: PS2 and original Xbox boundary research
done_when: The suite has a documented position on ps2_family and xbox_family.

title: PS3/Xbox 360 exclusion guardrail
done_when: The suite has an explicit exclusion policy and future re-entry criteria for ps3_family and xbox360_family.

title: Catalog coverage dashboard and unmet-family report
done_when: The backlog can report what is implemented, what is planned, what is archived, and why.

title: Promotion pipeline from archive to implementation wave
done_when: One archived family can be promoted cleanly into an implementation wave without rewriting the planning structure.
